scientific_claim: UNISON-StateBench measures whether model outputs preserve explicitly defined value, epistemic status, provenance, authority, and operational-state distinctions under controlled representation and evidence transformations.
claim_boundaries: The benchmark does not establish that a model understands truth in a general philosophical sense.
The benchmark does not establish arbitrary-agent containment or deployment safety.
S06 uses source-derived DoD memorandum context separately from synthetic exercise, remediation, and readiness state.
No single composite leaderboard score is defined for v0.1.
